scope: Geometry remaining circle relation, point location, orientation, point-segment distance, segment intersection, triangle area full/split
comparison_policy: Same frozen main, common I/O, problem data, compiler flags and check setting for complete submissions. API harness results are separated from complete submission process time. Baseline/control are identical source; comparisons are randomized within each repetition. No I/O changes are credited to the library.
accepted_changes: Integer contains skips edges wholly above/below query before determinant; boundary classification uses coordinate ranges without repeating orientation. Floating path retained.
Integer intersects classifies same-side, collinear and one-endpoint-on-line cases before unneeded determinants; floating path retained. Public on_segment unchanged.
Point-segment interior distance uses the absolute cross product with the normalized direction instead of constructing the closest point and taking a second norm.

Circle-circle normal-range center distance uses sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy). Largest component 0 or 1e-150..1e150 is safe from norm overflow/underflow on standard long double; other ranges retain hypot. Equal-center circles also avoid hypot.
Additional global scalar triangle APIs and circle classification API avoid vector allocation; correctness/allocation tests cover them. Their effect is not counted as a frozen-main speedup.
important_limits: Circle tiny/huge fallback workloads retain numerical scaling and pay approximately 5-9% extra dispatch cost in this measurement; no universal no-regression claim.
Orientation and existing vector area kernels are unchanged. Their actual GCC/Clang frozen-main .text sections are identical before/after; observed time differences are noise, not a body improvement.

Constant-size AtCoder problems mostly measure process startup and I/O. Their complete-process samples do not resolve the API speedup reliably. Largest contains inputs are included, but short-process timings still fluctuate.
Synthetic API inputs and measured compilers/CPU do not establish ranking against unrelated online submissions.
No new SIMD or CPU-detection implementation was introduced. Existing scalar long double behavior and standard fallback are retained.

api_measurements.timed_region: API calls and their result destruction, after input construction; no I/O in timed region

actual_main_measurements.method: Actual frozen problem main and common I/O. Process wall time includes startup and I/O. Constant-size inputs cannot resolve body speed reliably; API microbenchmarks are separate.

candidate_decisions.decision: Individual early candidates. Use final complete measurements for accepted claims.
Early integer whole-box rejection has 28-35% shared-endpoint regression; rejected.
Small-coordinate runtime narrowing speeds common input but is rejected together with wide results.
Runtime narrowing adds up to 14% on wide/translated segment input; orientation left unchanged.
Bounds-only on_segment and unconditional four-orientation integer kernel show distribution regressions; rejected. Boundary-first kernel selected and public on_segment restored.

reproduce.baseline: Snapshot /tmp/sirkit_four_hours_20261022/geometry/baseline; SIRKIT_GEOMETRY_TEST_HEADER selects an alternative same-version header for controlled comparisons.
